WITH f AS (SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) r FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT store_id, business_date sale_date, net_sales_before_returns n, receipts r FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT coalesce(f.store_id,r.store_id) store_id, coalesce(f.sale_date,r.sale_date) d, f.n fn, r.n rn, f.r fr, r.r rr FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.store_id=r.store_id AND f.sale_date=r.sale_date WHERE f.n IS NULL OR r.n IS NULL OR abs(f.n-r.n)>0.01 OR f.r<>r.r ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 100

calls.statement:
SELECT cs.format, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) net_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.format<>cs.format THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) fmt_diff
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
